Bug_Explanation: The bug 'TooFewBranchesForASwitchStatement' is embedded in the switch statement. The intentional bug is that for only weekdays and weekends are handled, while other day values (like 0 or any number outside 1-7) will lead to a null value being returned.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug 'TooFewBranchesForASwitchStatement' is triggered when the day value is not between 1 and 7, as these are the only values handled in the switch statement. In the test cases, assertNull is used to check for a null value, which is not returned for any valid day values in the switch statement.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results do not demonstrate the bug being triggered. The test cases for invalid day values (0 and 8) returned null as expected, which is the default value for the 'typeOfDay' variable when no case matches in the switch statement. This does not indicate the presence of the 'TooFewBranchesForASwitchStatement' bug.
